basic_details.short_information: The North Eastern Regional Agricultural Marketing Corporation (NERAMAC) has officially announced the Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 with 1 opening. The detailed notification was published on the official website, https://neramac.com. Candidates with a Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized University/Institute and a maximum age of 26 years are eligible to attend the walk-in interview on 10-08-2026. Direct links to download the official notification are shared below.

content_sections.heading: NERAMAC Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NERAMAC Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Assistant position at NERAMAC is scheduled for 10th August 2026. Candidates should ensure they report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized University or Institute to be eligible for the Project Assistant position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Assistant post is 26 years as of 1st August 2026. There is no minimum age specified.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the NERAMAC Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Assistant post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Assistant position in the North Eastern Regional Agricultural Marketing Corporation (NERAMAC) recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Interested and eligible candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and any other relevant certificates as mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview for NERAMAC Project Assistant to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781019. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant position is a contractual job. The duration and terms of the contract will be as per the organization's policy and the official notification.
